tasks.label: free-web-port
args: $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($null -ne $c) { $c | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; exit 0

tasks.label: free-api-port
args: $c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5081 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($null -ne $c) { $c | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; exit 0
